Use this skill for stream-based ARC tasks where each instance provides a task ID, a test grid, optional demonstration pairs, and a persistent per-task program library.

- Treat unchanged regions and objects as informative controls, not background noise. In particular, compare exceptional objects with similar but unchanged objects in the same demo.
